faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.mottoEn: Knowledge is Light, Action is Worship
faq.subtitle: Al-Imam Malick Islamic Institute - Under Sumpundoukati Society, Kanifing, The Gambia
faq.intro: Official answers about programs, admission, recognition and achievements of Imam Malick Islamic Institute.
faq.programsQuestion: What programs does the institute offer?
faq.programsAnswer: We offer a full integrated curriculum: Tahfiz (Qur'an Memorization - Full Qur'an), Islamic Studies and Arabic Language, Primary 4 to Preparatory 3, Junior Secondary and Senior Secondary (General Secondary Certificate). Our curriculum combines Islamic education, Arabic, and applied sciences for societal welfare (economic, health, social, political).
faq.locationAnswer: Al-Imam Malick Islamic Institute - Under Sumpundoukati Society, Kanifing, The Gambia, West Africa. We serve students from all regions of The Gambia and organize educational trips to Banjul National Museum, Kachikally Crocodile Pool, Abuko Zoo, Snake Village, Kartong, and Fathala Zoo in Senegal.
faq.recognitionAnswer: Yes. Our Secondary Certificate is officially recognized in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia by the Ministry of Education, in appreciation of our outstanding efforts in advancing Islamic and Arabic education in The Gambia. Graduates can continue higher studies in Saudi universities.
faq.awardsQuestion: What are your achievements and awards?
faq.awardsAnswer: Best Performing Islamic Institute in The Gambia - Awarded by the General Secretariat for Islamic and Arabic Education. First Place twice in the National Qur'an Competition (Full Qur'an Category) in The Gambia. First Place in the General Secretariat Examinations for the Junior Secondary category. We are also a proud member of the World Assembly of Muslim Youth (WAMY).
faq.enrollmentAnswer: Enrollment is through our admissions office in Kanifing. Academic year 2026/2027: First Term Exams begin 20 Feb 2027, Second Term begins 19 June 2027. Requirements: Birth certificate, previous school report, and two passport photos. Contact us for admission forms or visit the institute after working hours. Graduation for the 19th Batch is on 7 Aug 2027.
faq.tahfizAnswer: Yes. Tahfiz is a core program taught by qualified Sheikhs including Sheikh Muhammad Isa Haidara, Sheikh Omar Isa Dukure, and Sheikh Mahmoud Al-Lay. Our Sheikhs specialize in the importance of life skills, learning Qur'an with recitation and tadabbur, and the virtue of beneficial knowledge.
faq.agesQuestion: Is the institute open to all ages?
faq.agesAnswer: We accept students from Primary 4 to Senior Secondary. We organize academic seminars, lectures on sports and health, applied science, Tarbiyah, Cultural Week with traditional foods, and student trips.
faq.contactAnswer: Al-Imam Malick Islamic Institute, Under Sumpundoukati Society, Kanifing, The Gambia, West Africa. Follow our Events and News for seminars, administrative meetings, and trip schedules.
faq.footer: © Al-Imam Malick Islamic Institute - By Knowledge We Rise

security.title: Information Security Policy
security.subtitle: Al-Imam Malick Islamic Institute - Under Sumpundoukati Society, Kanifing, The Gambia
security.motto: Knowledge is Light, Action is Worship - العلم نور والعمل عبادة
security.introduction: Al-Imam Malick Islamic Institute (AMII), under Sumpundoukati Society in Kanifing, The Gambia, is committed to protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of all information collected, stored, or processed through our official website, student portal, and internal systems. This policy applies to students, parents, staff, and visitors of our Islamic and Arabic educational programs.
security.scopeNote: Scope: This policy covers our website, student records, Tahfiz and examination data, administrative meetings, and award certificates recognized by the Ministry of Education of Saudi Arabia and the General Secretariat for Islamic and Arabic Education.
security.dataProtectionText: We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to safeguard personal and institutional data from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. Student personal data, including admission forms, birth certificates, and Junior and Senior Secondary exam results, is classified as confidential.
security.dataPoint1: Encryption of admission and graduation records, including the 19th Batch of 2027
security.dataPoint2: No sharing of student Tahfiz progress without parental consent
security.practicesText: Our official website uses modern security standards:
security.practice1: Encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS 1.3), secure hosting, and regular updates
security.practice2: Protection of Events and News 2026/2027, awards at /awards, and student trip galleries
security.privacyText: Personal information submitted through admission forms, contact forms, or administrative meetings is handled with care and used only for legitimate educational purposes: enrollment, examinations, and communication about Cultural Week and student trips.
security.accessText: Only authorized staff have access to sensitive information. Access is granted based on role:
security.access1: Academic Committee: Sheikh Muhammad Isa Haidara, Sheikh Omar Isa Dukure, Sheikh Mahmoud Al-Lay, and Muhammad Toure
security.access2: Administration: full access to enrollment and financial records
security.access3: Teachers: limited to their class sections, from Primary 4 to Preparatory 3
security.storageText: Information is stored securely on encrypted servers and retained only as long as necessary for administrative, educational, or legal purposes. Graduation certificates, WAMY membership documents, and Saudi recognition letters are archived permanently with restricted access.
security.thirdPartyText: When using external services, including hosting, analytics, or the World Assembly of Muslim Youth (WAMY) platform, we ensure they follow industry-standard security practices and do not sell student data.
security.incidentText: In the event of a security breach or suspicious activity, we take immediate action to investigate, contain, and resolve the issue in coordination with the General Secretariat for Islamic and Arabic Education in The Gambia.
security.updatesText: This Information Security Policy may be updated periodically to reflect improvements, new regulations, or changes in technology. For questions, contact the institute administration in Kanifing after working hours.
security.commitment: Our Commitment: As the Best Performing Islamic Institute in The Gambia and a first-place holder in the National Qur'an Competition, we uphold the highest standards of Amanah in protecting your information.

biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text004:
Gambian Islamic scholar, educator, preacher, and community
            leader whose lifelong journey has been dedicated to knowledge,
            faith, teaching, and service.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text009:
From the Qur'anic learning circles of his village to
                studying at Al-Azhar University in Cairo, Ebrahima Marry
                Jagana's life has been shaped by a deep pursuit of
                knowledge and a commitment to serving Islam and his
                community.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text013:
Born in 1966 in New Demba Kunda, The Gambia, Ebrahima
                    Marry Jagana began his journey of learning through the
                    traditional Qur'anic education of his village.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text014:
His early studies gave him a foundation in the Qur'an
                    and Islamic knowledge. His desire to deepen that
                    knowledge eventually took him beyond his local
                    community and across the border to Senegal.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text016: A Journey from Village Learning to Al-Azhar
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text017:
Education remained a defining part of Ebrahima Marry
                    Jagana's life. His pursuit of Islamic knowledge took
                    him through several important stages of study and
                    training.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text020:
He began studying the Qur'an and Islamic
                            knowledge through the traditional learning
                            circles of his village.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text022:
In 1979, he travelled to neighbouring Senegal
                            to continue his studies in the Islamic
                            sciences and deepen his understanding of
                            religious knowledge.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text024:
In 1985, he received a scholarship to study at
                            Al-Azhar University in Cairo, one of the
                            world's historic centres of Islamic learning.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text027:
Between 1993 and 1994, he completed his
                            university studies and obtained a licence
                            degree in the Faculty of Education, with a
                            focus on Islamic Studies.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text029:
Following university, he undertook additional
                            training in Islamic preaching methods and
                            specialised Arabic-language studies organised
                            through Al-Azhar's Islamic outreach
                            institutions.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text033:
For Ebrahima Marry Jagana, the pursuit of knowledge was
                    closely connected to a responsibility to share it.
                    After returning from his educational journey, he began
                    teaching at an Islamic institute associated with the
                    Islamic Union of The Gambia.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text034:
From 1995 to 2004, he served in teaching and
                    administrative responsibilities, including work as a
                    secretary in the office of the Director of Education.
                    This period marked an important chapter in his
                    development as an educator and community servant.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text035:
In 2004, he moved to the Imam Malik Islamic Institute,
                    where he continued his educational and religious work,
                    serving as a teacher and deputy director of the
                    institute.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text039:
His work has extended far beyond formal teaching.
                    Throughout his career, he has served as a preacher,
                    religious guide, imam, and mentor, using different
                    platforms to reach members of his community.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text040:
His activities have included preaching, religious
                    education, public guidance, and participation in
                    Islamic committees and community initiatives.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text041:
He has also presented a religious programme on national
                    television on a weekly basis for more than fifteen
                    years, extending his educational work to a much wider
                    audience.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text045:
Dedicated to teaching Islamic knowledge and
                            supporting the education of students.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text047:
Participated in national Islamic committees
                            and community initiatives.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text049:
Presented a weekly religious programme on
                            national television for more than 15 years.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text051:
Continued religious teaching and guidance
                            through public lessons and community
                            platforms.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text054:
Served as an imam and Friday preacher at the
                            Imam Malik Institute mosque.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text056:
Shares regular religious lessons through
                            social media and online community groups.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text060:
Alongside his teaching and preaching, Ebrahima Marry
                    Jagana has taken part in wider Islamic and community
                    service. His documented activities include
                    responsibilities within national Islamic bodies and
                    committees.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text061:
His service has included executive responsibilities in
                    the Higher Islamic Council of The Gambia, including
                    financial responsibilities, as well as participation
                    in national committees concerned with Islamic affairs
                    and the interests of Muslim communities.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text062:
He has also contributed to religious education through
                    mosque-based teaching, Friday preaching, and regular
                    lessons shared through social communication platforms.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text067:
His profile reflects a combination of religious
                    scholarship, teaching experience, leadership, and
                    communication. He is particularly recognised for his
                    command of the Arabic language and his long-standing
                    involvement in Islamic education and preaching.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text068:
His documented skills include strong leadership,
                    excellent Arabic-language ability, and working
                    knowledge of English.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text070: A Life Built Around Knowledge and Service
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text071:
The story of Ebrahima Marry Jagana is ultimately a story
                    of a lifelong relationship with knowledge. From his
                    earliest Qur'anic studies in New Demba Kunda, through
                    his years of study in Senegal and at Al-Azhar, to his
                    decades of teaching and community service in The
                    Gambia, education has remained at the centre of his
                    journey.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text072:
His path illustrates a simple but enduring principle:
                    knowledge becomes most meaningful when it is shared
                    with others and placed in the service of the
                    community.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text073:
Through teaching, preaching, leadership, broadcasting,
                    and community engagement, he has continued to make
                    religious knowledge accessible to generations of
                    Gambians.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text074:
A lifelong journey of seeking knowledge,
                    sharing knowledge, and serving the community.
biography_ebrahim_marry_jagana.text075: Ebrahima Marry Jagana A Life of Knowledge

biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text004:
A Gambian Islamic scholar, Arabic language teacher, imam, and
            institute director whose journey has carried him from Sierra
            Leone to the Gambia, Egypt, and the United States in pursuit
            of knowledge and service.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text010:
Knowledge is light that guides hearts and mends life.
                This is the principle that has carried Malamin Zakaria
                Jagana across three countries and eleven years at
                Al-Azhar University, in a lifelong journey to learn,
                teach, and serve his community.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text014:
Malamin Zakaria Jagana was born in 1964 in Kedu Town,
                    in the west of Sierra Leone, to his father Haj
                    Zakaria Jagana and his mother Haja Sisi Kamara. His
                    father worked as a gemstone trader, and it was within
                    this family that his earliest sense of discipline and
                    purpose began to take shape.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text015:
While still young, he was sent to live with his uncle,
                    Haj Sheikh Hali Jagana, in the Upper River Region of
                    The Gambia. It was there, until the age of fifteen,
                    that he absorbed the religious and Soninke cultural
                    values that would guide the rest of his life.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text017: From Village Learning to Al-Azhar University
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text018:
His education followed a long and deliberate path,
                    carrying him through several countries and more than
                    two decades of study before he began his own teaching
                    career.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text020:
He memorized the Holy Qur'an at the school of
                            Haj Beely Miala Jagana, laying the foundation
                            for everything that followed.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text022:
He travelled to the village of Waoundé to
                            study Islamic jurisprudence under Sheikh Haj
                            Muhammad Sarando Jagana, spending four years
                            deepening his understanding of Islamic law.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text024:
He returned briefly to the village, working
                            the groundnut farms before continuing his
                            education the following year.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text026:
In early 1985, he travelled to his uncle Haj
                            Mari Haj in Banjul and joined the Fan Afrika
                            school in the village of Lamin, in the West
                            Coast Region.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text028:
Later that year, he was awarded a scholarship
                            to Al-Azhar University in Egypt, where he
                            spent eleven years studying Islamic religious
                            sciences, Arabic, English, and French.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text030:
He graduated from Al-Azhar University's
                            Faculty of Education, Arabic English
                            Department, with a Good grade bringing his
                            long educational journey to a close.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text034:
On returning to The Gambia, Malamin Zakaria Jagana was
                    appointed director of Simoudoughaty School now
                    known as the Imam Malik Islamic Institute under the
                    Simoudoughaty Association, a position he held for
                    four years.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text035:
This early leadership role set the tone for a career
                    that would combine classroom teaching with
                    institutional responsibility, a balance he would
                    carry through the rest of his working life.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text037: Seven Years of Teaching and Preaching in Brooklyn
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text038:
In 2000, he travelled to the United States, where he
                    served as a teacher and preacher at the Abdur Rahman
                    Mosque on Morris Street in Brooklyn, New York, for
                    seven years.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text039:
This period placed him at the heart of a Gambian and
                    West African diaspora community, where he continued
                    his work of religious teaching and guidance far from
                    home.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text044:
Teaches religious subjects and Arabic language
                            across primary, middle, and secondary levels.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text046:
Served as school director and later as
                            institute director for Culture, Dawah,
                            Guidance and Media.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text049:
Served as imam and preacher in the Gambia and
                            at Abdur Rahman Mosque in Brooklyn, USA.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text051:
Prepares cultural and media programmes for
                            the Imam Malik Islamic Institute.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text053:
Works fluently across Soninke, Arabic,
                            English, and French-speaking communities.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text055:
Brings decades of organisational and
                            administrative experience to Islamic
                            education.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text058: Back Home at the Imam Malik Islamic Institute
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text059:
In late 2007, Malamin Zakaria Jagana returned to The
                    Gambia and rejoined the Imam Malik Islamic Institute
                    in Sukuta, where he has remained ever since.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text060:
There, he teaches religious and humanities subjects
                    across the primary, middle, and secondary sections,
                    while also serving as the institute's Director of
                    Culture, Dawah, Guidance and Media — a role he has
                    held since the same year.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text061:
Together, these two roles reflect the dual nature of
                    his life's work: shaping students in the classroom,
                    and shaping the wider cultural and religious life of
                    the institute and its community.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text066:
His documented skills include teaching religious
                    subjects and the Arabic language, school
                    administration and organisational management, dawah,
                    guidance and public speaking, and the preparation of
                    cultural and media programmes.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text067:
He is also recognised for his ability to communicate
                    across different cultures — a strength shaped by a
                    life lived between Sierra Leone, The Gambia, Egypt,
                    and the United States, and reflected in his fluency in
                    Soninke, Arabic, English, and French.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text069: A Journey Built on Knowledge and Service
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text070:
The story of Malamin Zakaria Jagana is one of
                    persistence — a childhood shaped across two countries,
                    years of Qur'anic and fiqh study in village learning
                    circles, and eleven years of formal study at one of
                    the Islamic world's most respected universities.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text071:
That foundation has carried into decades of teaching,
                    school leadership, preaching, and cultural guidance
                    first in the Gambia, then in the United States, and
                    now back home again at the Imam Malik Islamic
                    Institute.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text072:
Through every stage, his path has reflected the words
                    he holds closest: that knowledge is light, and that
                    its purpose is to guide hearts and mend life.
biography_malamin_zakaria_jagana.text073:
Knowledge is light that guides hearts and mends
                    life.

biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text001: Former General Director • Al-Azhar Graduate • Founder of Karate in The Gambia
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text004: Gambian educator and General Director of Imam Malik Islamic Institute. Born in Kaba Kunda, Basse, and a graduate of Al-Azhar University Cairo in 1992 with a Higher Licence in Education, he taught for 13 years at the Islamic Institute Tallinding Kunja, then served as Deputy Director of Examinations and Director of Activities, before leading Imam Malik Institute and serving as Imam and Khateeb of Sinbo Doqati Mosque with lectures across villages and mosques.
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text008: Pioneer of Karate in The Gambia
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text009: From Kaba Kunda in Basse to Al-Azhar in Cairo, and from the classrooms of Tallinding Kunja to founding a national discipline the life of Mahmadu Musa Kabba was a legacy of knowledge, discipline, courage and service.
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text011: Official portrait - Mbala Karate Club - In honor of his legacy
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text014: Born in Kaba Kunda family, Basi Ongari, Upper River Region. He began learning from his father Al-Hajj Musa Kaba and his elder brother Al-Hajj Muhammad Baghori Kaba, before traveling to Cairo where he earned his preparatory, secondary and Licence from the College of Education, Al-Azhar University, graduating in 1992.
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text016: Teacher for 13 years, then Deputy Director of Examinations, Deputy Director of Culture, Da'wah and Guidance, and Director of Activities until 2003-2004.
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text018: Imam Malik Islamic Institute - Former General Director
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text019: Teacher, then General Director of Imam Malik Institute and its branches. Imam and Khateeb of Sinbo Doqati Mosque, with halaqas in many mosques and lectures in villages and rural areas.
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text021: Mahmadu Musa Kabba: A Legacy of Discipline, Courage, and Service
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text022: Mahmadu Musa Kabba, the former director of the institute, was a pioneering figure in The Gambia.
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text023: The Founder of Karate in The Gambia
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text024: He introduced the art of self-defense known as Karate to the country and registered it legally, laying the foundation for a national discipline that shaped generations. Under his guidance, countless students trained with dedication including politicians, members of the Gambian Armed Forces, and even the President himself. His impact extended far beyond the dojo, influencing character, discipline, and national pride.
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text025: May Allah forgive him and grant him Jannah.
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text030: Former General Director of Imam Malik Institute, 13 years at Tallinding Kunja, Deputy Director of Examinations and Activities.
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text033: Imam and Khateeb of Sinbo Doqati Mosque, regular halaqas and village lectures across The Gambia.
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text035: Introduced Karate to The Gambia, legally registered the discipline, founded Mbala Karate Club.
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text037: Trained generations including politicians, Gambian Armed Forces, and the President building discipline and national pride.
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text038: Only those fear Allah, from among His servants, who have knowledge In loving memory of Mahmadu Musa Kabba Muhammad Kaba Musa Rahimahullah
biography_muhammad_kaba_musa.text039: May Allah forgive him and grant him Jannah

biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text004: A Gambian teacher of Arabic language and Islamic studies. Since 2012 at Imam Malik Islamic Institute, he serves as Imam and Khateeb, educator in Arabic and Shari'ah, and presenter on Radio Gambia dedicated to da'wah, education and media outreach.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text009: From the primary school of his village Al-Wanfari to graduating from the International University of Africa, Baguri Kisma Sangare has carried a single conviction: calling to Allah is a responsibility, teaching is a message, and working for Allah is worship.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text013: Born in 1984 in Al-Wanfari, The Gambia, Baguri Kisma Sangare began his education in his village. A Gambian national and family man, he showed early commitment to Arabic and Islamic studies that would lead him beyond his community to higher education.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text016: His academic journey reflects consistent dedication, moving step by step from primary education to university graduation.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text018: Completed his primary stage in his village Al-Wanfari, establishing his foundation in Islamic and general education.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text019: Preparatory Stage — Islamic Institute, Banding Kunja
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text020: Joined the Islamic Institute in Banding Kunja and completed his preparatory certificate, deepening his studies in Arabic and Islamic sciences.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text022: Completed his secondary studies, preparing for higher education in Islamic studies.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text023: University Degree — International University of Africa
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text024: Enrolled at the International University of Africa, specializing in Islamic Studies. Graduated in 2010 with a university degree in Islamic studies, marking the culmination of his academic journey from village to university.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text027: His qualifications include the primary certificate, preparatory certificate, secondary certificate, and university degree in Islamic Studies each representing a stage of growth from foundational learning to specialized academic training.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text031: Teacher at Imam Malik Islamic Institute, continuously serving since 2012 in Arabic and Islamic studies.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text034: Serves as Imam and Friday preacher, delivering sermons and religious guidance.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text036: Administrator at Imam Malik Institute, Deputy Director of Da'wah and Guidance Affairs, and Secretary of the institute.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text038: Presenter and da'iyah on Radio Gambia (Ida'ah Gambia), extending Islamic education to a national audience.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text041: Member of the Media and Public Relations Committee, managing outreach and communication.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text043: Skilled in computer use, supporting modern educational and administrative work.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text047: His language skills reflect both scholarly training and community roots. Arabic at an excellent level, English very good, Soninke as mother tongue, and Mandinka at an excellent level. This combination allows him to teach and preach across diverse Gambian communities.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text048: Beyond teaching, his experience includes teaching Arabic and Shari'ah sciences, da'wah through radio, and administrative leadership in education and media.
biography_baguri_kisma_sangare.text049: Calling to Allah is a responsibility, teaching is a message, and working for Allah is worship Baguri Kisma Sangare

biography_dr_ali_jagana.text001: Professor of Hadith • Author • Researcher • Verifier
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text003: Professor of Noble Hadith and Islamic Studies. A researcher and author whose academic path led from The Gambia to the Islamic University of Madinah, where he completed his Bachelor's, Master's and Doctorate in Hadith and Islamic Studies.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text008: The academic journey of Dr. Ali Jagana is rooted in a deep commitment to the Noble Hadith. From joining the Islamic University of Madinah in 2004 to becoming a professor, author, and verifier, his work focuses on preserving, explaining, and investigating the Sunnah.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text012: Dr. Ali Jagana joined the Islamic University of Madinah in 2004, undertaking the full academic track from undergraduate to postgraduate studies in the Faculty of Hadith and Islamic Studies. He completed this demanding journey in 2019.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text013: His specialization has always been centered on the sciences of the prophetic tradition its narration, explanation, authentication, and preservation.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text014: Enrollment at the Islamic University of Madinah
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text015: Joined the Faculty of Hadith and Islamic Studies to begin his higher Islamic education in the City of the Prophet.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text019: from the Chapter of Intent and Excess to the Chapter of Shaving and Haircutting. A critical study and verification of a classical Hadith commentary manuscript.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text020: Doctorate in Hadith and Islamic Studies
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text021: Doctoral dissertation focusing on classical Hadith literature, textual verification, and scholarly annotation, continuing his work on manuscript investigation and commentary.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text023: Completed a second doctoral thesis in Arabic linguistics, titled
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text025: a study on precise linguistic expressions, presented through the Islamic University of Madinah's program in Senegal.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text028: Dr. Ali Jagana is the author of several printed works that combine poetic composition, biographical scholarship, and Hadith literature.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text029: 1. Sharh al-Arjuza al-Mi'iyya fi Dhikr Hal Ashraf al-Bariyya
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text030: A commentary on the famous 100-line poem on the Seerah of the Prophet, peace be upon him. (Printed)
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text031: 2. Al-Qawl al-'Ilmi fi Sharh Zad al-Talib
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text032: A scholarly explanation in the field of Hadith studies. (Printed)
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text034: A collection of his own poetry reflecting Islamic themes and literary expression. (Printed)
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text036: A comprehensive compilation of attributed narrations and texts. (Printed)
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text039: Beyond books, his academic footprint extends to eight published, peer-reviewed studies in accredited scientific journals, covering Hadith verification, Seerah, and Arabic sciences.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text040: The Transmission of al-Bukhari and Muslim from the Companions:
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text041: A study on their combined narrations, their collection and authentication published in the Journal of Islamic Sciences, Issue 199, 1443 AH / 2021.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text043: Critical notes on a didactic poem in Hadith sciences.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text044: The Hadith of Umm Waraqa and the Issue of Women Leading Men in Prayer:
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text045: Textual analysis and jurisprudential implications 1443 AH / 2022.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text046: Al-Ahadith wa al-Athar al-Warida fi al-Sunan al-Majhula:
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text047: A critical study of narrations on forgotten Sunnahs 1445 AH / 2024.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text049: An analytical study of classical hadith terminology principles 1447 AH / 2025.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text050: Teaching Hadith Sciences in African Universities:
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text051: A model curriculum for academic programs 2025.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text052: Wird Harf (Ha) in the Prophetic Hadith:
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text053: A textual and analytical study published with textual verification from manuscripts of the Prophet's Mosque Library.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text054: Al-Ishraf al-Sahih from the Writings of the Salaf:
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text055: An academic investigation 2026, a new contribution to authentic scholarly verification.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text057: A Researcher Between Hadith, Language and Verification
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text059: Specialist in the Noble Hadith, its chains, texts, and sciences.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text061: Author of commentaries on Seerah poetry and biographical literature.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text063: Expert in Tahqiq — critical editing and verification of classical manuscripts.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text065: Second doctorate in Arabic language and linguistics, focusing on precise expression.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text068: Active researcher with contributions to refereed journals and academic conferences.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text070: Interest in the principles of Fiqh and methods of legal deduction.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text073: Dr. Ali Jagana combines the three core roles of the classical Muhaddith: searching for knowledge, verifying it, and teaching it. His work reflects academic precision, literary depth, and a strong commitment to authentic transmission.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text074: As a professor of Hadith and Islamic Studies, he continues to teach, supervise research, verify manuscripts, and contribute to the intellectual life of the Muslim community in The Gambia and beyond.
biography_dr_ali_jagana.text075: And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge Dr. Ali Jagana

biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text004:
A Gambian academic and Islamic jurist, specialised in Fiqh
            and Sharia Studies, whose path from Dakar to Madinah has
            produced published research, a doctorate, and a career
            devoted to teaching and guidance.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text009:
An academic and sharia researcher specialised in Islamic
                Fiqh, Dr. Fodi Jagana has built a body of distinguished
                scholarly work in research and authorship, matched by
                years of experience in university teaching, guidance,
                and da'wah.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text013: From Dakar's Classrooms to Madinah's Faculty of Sharia
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text014:
Dr. Fodi Jagana's academic journey began in Dakar,
                    Senegal, where he completed his primary, middle, and
                    secondary education at schools of the Al-Falah
                    Movement — a foundation that set him on a path of
                    formal, structured learning from an early age.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text015:
That foundation carried him to Saudi Arabia, where he
                    joined the Faculty of Sharia at the Islamic University
                    of Madinah. It was there that his academic path
                    deepened significantly, moving step by step from
                    undergraduate to doctoral study.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text018:
Completed primary, middle, and secondary
                            education at Al-Falah Movement schools in
                            Dakar, Senegal.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text021:
Joined the Faculty of Sharia at the Islamic
                            University of Madinah and earned his
                            bachelor's degree there.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text024:
Remained at the Islamic University of Madinah
                            to pursue a master's degree in the Department
                            of Fiqh.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text027:
Completed his doctoral studies in the
                            Department of Fiqh, becoming Dr. Fodi Jagana.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text031:
Across his academic career, Dr. Fodi Jagana has
                    produced a body of research spanning fiqh, da'wah,
                    and Islamic history — work that has been presented at
                    academic symposia and published through respected
                    institutions.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text032: Master's Thesis on Imam al-Shanqiti's Fiqh
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text033:
"The Fiqh Choices of Sheikh Muhammad
                                al-Amin al-Shanqiti in Worship, through
                                Adwaa' al-Bayan — Compilation and Study,"
                                published by the Deanship of Scientific
                                Research at the Islamic University of
                                Madinah.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text035:
A scholarly paper examining the ruling on
                                seeking assistance from others in academic
                                research and writing.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text036: Wise Positions from the Lives of the Prophets
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text037:
"Wise Positions from the Lives of
                                Preachers, with Ibrahim (peace be upon
                                him) as an Example," presented at the
                                symposium "Wisdom in Renewing Da'wah
                                Discourse" at the Islamic University of
                                Madinah, 1435H / 2014.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text038: Forum of Saudi Graduates, West Africa
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text039:
Presented "The Efforts of Saudi University
                                Graduates in Explaining Moderation and
                                Warning against Extremism, Gambia as an
                                Example" at the Forum of Saudi University
                                Graduates from West Africa, held in the
                                Gambia, 1438H.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text041:
Authored the book "The Precious Gem in the
                                History of New Dembakunda," published in
                                2020.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text046:
Member of the teaching faculty at the
                            University of Ihsan, The Gambia.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text048:
Member of the teaching faculty at Faith
                            University, The Gambia.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text050:
Advises on administration at the Imam Malik
                            Islamic Institute in Kanifing, The Gambia.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text053:
Serves as imam and preacher of Saleha Samir
                            Al-Mutairi Mosque in Sukuta, The Gambia.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text055:
Published author of research papers and a
                            book on local Islamic history.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text058:
Active voice in promoting moderation and
                            countering extremism in Islamic discourse.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text063:
Dr. Fodi Jagana's expertise spans scientific research
                    and verification, university-level teaching, writing
                    and authorship, preaching and guidance, and the
                    management of educational programmes and
                    institutions.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text064:
This range of skills reflects a career built as much
                    on the page as on the pulpit — someone equally at
                    home producing academic research as he is teaching a
                    lecture hall or delivering a Friday sermon.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text066: A Scholar's Path, From Dakar to Madinah and Home
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text067:
The path of Dr. Fodi Jagana traces a clear arc: from
                    early schooling in Dakar, through a bachelor's,
                    master's, and doctorate at the Islamic University of
                    Madinah, to a career of teaching, research, and
                    religious leadership back home in The Gambia.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text068:
His published research on fiqh, moderation, and the
                    lives of the prophets — alongside his book on local
                    Islamic history — reflects a scholar committed not
                    only to studying knowledge, but to recording and
                    sharing it for future generations.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text069:
Today, through his work at two universities, an
                    Islamic institute, and a mosque, he continues to
                    carry that same mission forward: knowledge pursued,
                    lived, and passed on.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text070:
Knowledge is worship, acting upon it is a mission,
                    and calling to it is the path of the prophets.
biography_dr_fodi_jagana.text071: Dr. Fodi Jagana A Life of Research, Teaching

biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text003: Gambian Islamic scholar, preacher and researcher — PhD in Fiqh from the Islamic University of Madinah — with extensive experience in teaching, research, da'wah and institutional work in The Gambia and Saudi Arabia.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text009: From early Islamic education in The Gambia to earning his Bachelor's, Master's and Doctorate at the Islamic University of Madinah, Dr. Kisma Sheikh Sahoo has dedicated his life to seeking authentic knowledge, teaching it, and serving the community through scholarship and guidance.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text012: Who is Dr. Kisma Sheikh Sahoo?
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text013: Dr. Kisma Sheikh Sahoo is a Gambian scholar of Islamic sciences, a preacher (da'iyah), researcher, and teacher. He originates from Basse area, The Gambia, and holds Gambian nationality.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text014: His profile describes him as an academic with wide scientific and administrative experience in teaching, research, da'wah, and institutional work both in The Gambia and in Saudi Arabia with a clear passion for spreading Islamic knowledge and serving society.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text016: A Journey to the City of the Prophet
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text017: His educational path shows steady progression from foundational Islamic schooling in The Gambia to the highest level of academic study at one of the world's leading Islamic universities.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text019: From the Institute affiliated with the Islamic Union The Gambia, obtaining his primary certificate in Islamic studies.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text021: From the same institute - the Islamic Union Institute, The Gambia - continuing his preparatory level studies.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text023: Completed his secondary Islamic education through the Islamic Union, The Gambia.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text024: Bachelor's in Sharia - Islamic University of Madinah
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text025: Enrolled at the Islamic University of Madinah, Faculty of Sharia, where he obtained his Bachelor's degree in Sharia - a major milestone in his academic journey.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text027: Master's degree from the Islamic University of Madinah, Faculty of Sharia, specializing in Comparative Fiqh. His research focused on Islamic legal theory and comparative jurisprudential issues.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text029: PhD in Fiqh from the Islamic University of Madinah, Faculty of Sharia, specializing in the field of Islamic jurisprudence. His doctoral research addressed contemporary Fiqh issues, reflecting depth in analysis and academic research methodology.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text033: Since 1998, Dr. Sahoo has been active as an imam, preacher, and teacher. His experience includes years of teaching in Islamic schools, preaching in mosques, and serving in educational administration.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text034: His record includes extensive work in da'wah and teaching in The Gambia, supervising research, mentoring students, and participating in Islamic committees. He has also served in roles connected to the Hajj mission (2001-2006 experience as guide/educator for pilgrims) and worked with Islamic institutes for more than 20 years.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text035: Between his studies in Madinah and his work in The Gambia, he has built a profile that combines academic research with practical community education.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text041: Long experience in teaching Islamic sciences at different levels, from primary to advanced.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text044: Active as a preacher and imam, delivering sermons, lessons and religious guidance.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text046: Researcher in Fiqh and comparative Fiqh, with Master's and PhD theses in the field.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text049: Supervising student research and mentoring new teachers and students of knowledge.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text052: Author of research papers and contributions in Islamic jurisprudence.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text055: 15+ years of service (2001-2006) as a guide and educator for Gambian Hajj pilgrims.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text059: Dr. Sahoo is a member of several Islamic bodies. His CV notes membership in the Higher Islamic Council of The Gambia and other scientific and da'wah associations, including roles related to Fatwa and Islamic guidance.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text060: He also collaborates with charitable and educational institutions, combining da'wah with social service, and is known for his involvement in organizing scientific competitions, Qur'an memorization programs (1426-1427 AH), and Islamic awareness activities.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text065: His competencies include strong skills in teaching, research methodology, and community leadership. Linguistically, he is noted for excellent command of Arabic (language of study), proficiency in Soninke as a mother tongue, and good command of English.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text066: These language skills have enabled him to teach diverse audiences and to serve as a bridge between Arab and West African scholarly traditions.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text070: Among his documented achievements: participation in Qur'an and Sunnah competitions in The Gambia, receiving academic distinctions during his studies in Madinah, ranking first in several competitions at the Islamic University, and participation in scholarly conferences and Islamic programs.
biography_dr_kisma_sahoo.text071: His journey from Basse to Madinah and back to serving his community stands as a model of seeking knowledge abroad and returning to benefit one's people.

biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text005:
A Gambian university lecturer, imam, preacher, Islamic
            caller, and certified reciter of the Qur'an, whose academic
            path stretches from a village Qur'anic school to a doctorate
            earned in Madinah.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text010:
From a village Qur'anic school under Sheikh Haj Fodi
                Hekru Kiya to earning an Ijazah in the Seven Qira'at at
                the Prophet's Mosque itself, Dr. Suleiman Muhammad
                Camara's journey is one of steady, unbroken devotion to
                the Qur'an as memoriser, reciter, scholar, and teacher.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text014: A Long Road Through the Sciences of the Qur'an
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text015:
Born on 25 May 1987, Dr. Suleiman Muhammad Camara
                    began his education in a village Kuttab, under the
                    guidance of Sheikh Haj Fodi Hekru Kiya — may God have
                    mercy on him. From there, his education advanced
                    steadily through a series of Islamic institutions,
                    each stage building toward a deep specialisation in
                    the Qur'anic sciences.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text017:
Graduated from the primary stage at the
                            Islamic School of Jama'a al-Salafiyya in
                            Dembakunda.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text019:
Earned his middle school certificate at the
                            Islamic Institute in Talinding, Kanifing.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text021:
Completed his certificate in the memorisation
                            of the Holy Qur'an at Al-Noor Islamic
                            Institute.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text023:
Completed secondary studies at the Islamic
                            Institute in Talinding, Kanifing, then
                            pursued a second course of secondary study at
                            a religious institute in Qatar, completed in
                            2007.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text025:
Admitted in 2007 to the Faculty of the Noble
                            Qur'an at the Islamic University of Madinah,
                            earning his bachelor's degree in 2013.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text028:
Completed his master's degree, and in the same
                            year obtained an Ijazah in the Seven Qira'at
                            through study circles at the Prophet's Mosque
                            in Madinah.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text030:
Completed his doctoral studies, earning the
                            title of Dr. Suleiman Muhammad Camara.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text033: From the Classroom to University Leadership
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text034:
Alongside his studies, Dr. Camara built a long record
                    of teaching and institutional responsibility, moving
                    from classroom instruction to supervisory and
                    leadership roles in Islamic education.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text035: Teacher and Qur'an memorisation instructor at Imam Malik Institute
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text036: Teacher in the study circles of the Prophet's Mosque, Madinah
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text037: Field supervisor, Haj Mari Jagana Centre (Teta), Imam Malik Institute
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text041: Director of Examinations Administration, University of Ihsan
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text042: Dean, Faculty of Usul al-Din, Al-Ghaith University
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text047:
Teaches the Islamic sciences across
                            institute and university settings.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text049:
Teaches Qur'anic recitation and issues
                            Ijazahs, holding certification in the Seven
                            Qira'at.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text051:
Has led examinations administration and
                            served as Dean of a Faculty.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text054:
Serves as an imam, khatib, and Islamic
                            caller in the community.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text057:
Brings practical computing and
                            administrative skills to his academic roles.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text059:
Fluent in Soninke, Arabic, English, and
                            Mandinka.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text063:
Dr. Camara's linguistic ability mirrors the breadth
                    of communities he has served. Soninke is his mother
                    tongue, and he holds excellent command of Arabic and
                    Mandinka, alongside very good proficiency in English —
                    a range that allows his teaching and preaching to
                    reach a wide cross-section of Gambian society.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text065: A Journey Rooted in the Qur'an
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text066:
The path of Dr. Suleiman Muhammad Camara traces one
                    continuous thread from beginning to end: a lifelong
                    closeness to the Qur'an. From memorisation as a child
                    in a village Kuttab, to years of teaching in the
                    study circles of the Prophet's Mosque, to earning an
                    Ijazah in the Seven Qira'at and a doctorate, his
                    story is built on discipline, recitation, and
                    scholarship.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text067:
Today, as a university lecturer, examinations
                    director, and dean, he carries that same discipline
                    into institutional leadership shaping not only
                    students, but the structures through which Islamic
                    education is delivered in The Gambia.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text068:
As an imam, khatib, and certified reciter, his voice
                    continues to guide congregations just as his
                    scholarship continues to guide students.
biography_dr_suleiman_kamara.text069:
The best among you are those who learn the Qur'an
                    and teach it.

biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text001: Da'iyah • Teacher of Shari'ah • Community Educator
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text003: A Gambian da'iyah and teacher of Shari'ah sciences, striving to spread knowledge and da'wah to Allah with wisdom and beautiful preaching, and to build a generation rooted in knowledge, faith, and service to the community.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text009: Since his youth in The Gambia, Jafara Foday Gumaneh has dedicated his life to seeking Islamic knowledge and sharing it. A teacher in Islamic institutes since 1992, he combines traditional learning with decades of practical experience in teaching, preaching, and youth guidance.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text012: A Life Dedicated to Knowledge and Da'wah
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text013: Born in 1969 in The Gambia, Jafara Foday Gumaneh began seeking Islamic knowledge at an early age. From 1988 onward, he devoted himself to learning, memorizing, and studying under scholars, before moving into teaching and da'wah.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text014: His vision is clear and consistent: to spread authentic Shari'ah knowledge, invite to Allah with wisdom and good advice, and contribute to building a faithful, educated generation that serves its religion and community through learning, guidance, and good character.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text017: His educational path was built within The Gambia's leading Islamic institutes, combining Shari'ah studies with training in education.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text019: Institute of Islamic Sciences The Gambia
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text020: Completed his Shari'ah secondary certificate at the Institute of Islamic Sciences in The Gambia, establishing his foundation in Islamic sciences.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text022: Imam Malik Islamic Institute The Gambia
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text023: Obtained a higher diploma in Islamic studies from Imam Malik Islamic Institute, deepening his studies in Qur'an, Hadith, Fiqh and Seerah.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text026: Completed a specialized diploma combining Shari'ah and Islamic education methodology, preparing him for teaching and curriculum development.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text028: More Than Three Decades of Teaching
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text029: Since 1992, Jafara Foday Gumaneh has been a teacher in Islamic institutes and schools, a period spanning over 30 years of continuous educational service.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text031: Teaching Qur'an al-Kareem, Hadith, Fiqh, and Seerah in institutes and schools.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text033: Serving as Imam and Friday preacher for many years, guiding worshippers through sermons and lessons.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text035: Active participation in da'wah programs, awareness campaigns, and community education.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text037: Supervising halaqas for Qur'an memorization and mentoring youth and students of knowledge.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text040: Commitment to continuous learning has remained central to his work, with specialized training across core Islamic disciplines.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text042: Advanced courses in Qur'anic exegesis and Qur'anic sciences.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text044: Specialized studies in Hadith sciences and its terminology.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text046: Studies in Fiqh and Usul al-Fiqh, principles and applications.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text048: Training in da'wah methodology, preaching skills, and community outreach.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text054: Over 30 years explaining Shari'ah sciences with clarity and sincerity.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text056: Known for effective khutbah, public speaking, and da'wah with wisdom.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text058: Providing religious guidance and mentorship to youth and families.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text060: Preparing curricula, managing study circles, and organizing educational programs.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text063: Organizing programs for youth and children, Qur'an competitions and da'wah campaigns.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text066: Strong interpersonal communication and effective use of modern tools in teaching.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text070: Fluent in Soninke as a mother tongue, with strong command of Mandinka, very good Arabic (read), good English, and good Mandinka allowing him to teach and preach across different communities in The Gambia.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text071: He is recognized for personal qualities that define an educator: commitment, discipline, sincerity, love for knowledge and teaching, perseverance in work, team spirit, and dedication to collective effort.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text074: His mission centers on spreading authentic Shari'ah knowledge, nurturing students who adhere to the Book of Allah and the Sunnah, and building generations that benefit the Ummah. A vision pursued through teaching, da'wah, guidance, and dedicated community service.
biography_jaafar_fodi_gumani.text075: Spreading Shari'ah knowledge and calling to Allah with wisdom and beautiful preaching Jafara Foday Gumaneh

biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text001: Master's in Education • Curriculum Developer • Educator
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text003: A Gambian educator and specialist in Arabic language education, with a Master's in Education. Serving as Arabic language teacher at Imam Malik Institute since 2004, Director of Educational Affairs, and active Imam and Khateeb.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text008: From early studies in Mali to higher education in Sudan, and over two decades of teaching Arabic in The Gambia, Muhammad Issa Haydara represents a journey of dedication to education, curriculum development, and community guidance.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text012: Born on 28 August 1972 in Masra - Mariam, The Gambia, Muhammad Issa Haydara is a Gambian national whose life has been centered on education. Married and residing in Masra - Mariam, he has built his career around teaching Arabic, guiding students, and improving educational standards.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text013: His focus has always been practical and impactful: preparing curricula, managing educational affairs, and standing on the minbar to guide the community.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text015: A Path Through Mali and Sudan
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text016: His academic formation took him across the region, from traditional foundational learning to specialized university training in Arabic language education.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text019: Completed his primary and preparatory education in Mali, establishing a strong foundation in Arabic and Islamic studies.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text023: Continued his secondary and university studies in Sudan, specializing in Education, Arabic Language Department, where he developed expertise in teaching methodology and Arabic linguistics.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text026: Obtained a Master's degree in Education, specializing in Arabic Language, combining pedagogical theory with linguistic specialization.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text029: His linguistic profile reflects both his heritage and his professional specialization. Soninke is his mother tongue. Arabic is at an excellent level, the language of his teaching and research. French is also excellent. English is very good, in addition to knowledge of several local Gambian languages.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text030: This multilingual capacity enables him to teach diverse student populations and contribute to curriculum development that serves a wide community.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text034: Specialist in preparing and developing academic curricula for Arabic and Islamic education.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text036: Responsible for managing and overseeing educational affairs and academic quality.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text038: Arabic language teacher at Imam Malik Institute, serving continuously from 2004 to the present.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text040: Active Imam and Friday preacher, delivering regular sermons and religious lessons.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text042: Member of the Examinations Committee under the General Secretariat for Arabic and Islamic Studies in The Gambia.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text044: Previously and currently a member of the national curriculum committee for Arabic and Islamic education.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text047: Since 2004, his work at Imam Malik Institute has shaped generations of students. Through classroom teaching, administrative leadership, curriculum design, and minbar guidance, he has contributed to raising the standard of Arabic language education in The Gambia.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text048: His role in national examination and curriculum committees reflects a commitment that goes beyond a single institute working to improve the quality of Arabic and Islamic education at a national level.
biography_muhammad_issa_haydar.text049: Preparing curricula and serving Arabic and Islamic education Muhammad Issa Haydara

biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text001: Teacher of Qur'an • Master's in Qur'anic Sciences • Sudan Graduate
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text003: A Gambian teacher of the Holy Qur'an and its sciences. From memorizing the Qur'an in Demba Kunda in 2001 to earning a Master's in Sudan, he now teaches Tafsir and Tajweed at Imam Malik Institute and contributes to its educational and financial administration.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text008: The story of Muhammad Jola Camara begins in Demba Kunda and extends to the universities of Sudan a journey driven by a single purpose: to serve the Book of Allah through learning, teaching, and building faithful Qur'anic generations.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text011: From Demba Kunda to the Qur'an
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text012: Born on 10 February 1987 in Demba Kunda, The Gambia, Muhammad Jola Camara began his educational journey in his village at the school of the Salafi Islamic Association. His early inclination toward the Qur'an led him to the Sheikh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyyah Qur'anic School in Bantan, where he studied under Sheikh Ahmad Somali.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text013: In 2001, he completed the memorization of the Holy Qur'an a foundational achievement that shaped his entire future path as a teacher and educator.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text016: After completing his Hifz, he joined the Islamic Institute in Banjul, completing his preparatory and secondary studies in the academic year 2006/2007. Seeking higher Islamic education, he traveled to Sudan.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text017: Hifz al-Qur'an Sheikh al-Islam Ibn Taymiyyah School
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text018: Certificate of memorization of the Holy Qur'an, with proficiency and Tajweed, under the supervision of Sheikh Ahmad Somali.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text020: Completed secondary studies at the Islamic Institute, building the academic foundation for university education.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text021: Bachelor's Degree International University of Africa, Sudan
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text022: Traveled to Sudan and enrolled at the International University of Africa, Faculty of the Holy Qur'an. Obtained his Bachelor's degree in Qur'anic studies.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text023: Master's Degree University of the Holy Qur'an and Islamic Sciences, Sudan
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text024: Continued his postgraduate studies at the University of the Holy Qur'an and Islamic Sciences in Sudan, earning his Master's degree in Qur'anic and Islamic sciences.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text027: Certificate in Computer Basics from the UNESCO Center for International Relations Sudan (2008) and Certificate in Scientific Courses from the Complex of the Two Parents (Majma' al-Walidain) Islamic Center Sudan (2009).
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text030: Teaching has been at the center of his life since his youth, moving from mosque circles to institutes and international schools.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text031: Teacher of Qur'an Halaqah Old Demba Kunda Mosque
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text032: Began teaching Qur'an circles in his local mosque in Demba Kunda, serving students in memorization and Tajweed from 2001 to 2007.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text033: Teacher of Qur'an and Tajweed Imam Malik Institute
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text034: Joined Imam Malik Islamic Institute as a teacher of the Holy Qur'an and Tajweed, contributing to its Qur'an program.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text035: Teacher of Qur'an Sudanese Schools, Sudan
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text036: During his postgraduate studies, taught the Holy Qur'an in Sudanese schools in Sudan, gaining international teaching experience.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text039: Served as Imam at Dar al-Hadith Center, Ndum, leading prayers and providing religious guidance.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text043: Currently a senior participant at Imam Malik Institute, specializing in teaching Qur'anic subjects including Tafsir and Tajweed, and also serving in financial administration of the institute.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text046: Dedicated to the Qur'an and Education
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text048: Specialized in teaching the Holy Qur'an, its sciences, and memorization methodology.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text051: Expert in Tajweed rules and Qur'anic recitation, with years of practical teaching.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text053: Experienced in managing educational programs and academic affairs.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text055: Contributing to the financial administration of Imam Malik Institute.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text057: Certified in basic computer applications, supporting modern educational work.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text059: Skilled in preparing scientific programs and educational courses for students.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text063: Fluent in Arabic, English, Soninke, and Mandinka, he is able to teach and communicate across The Gambia's diverse communities.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text064: His mission is clear: to strive in serving the Book of Allah, to spread beneficial knowledge, and to contribute to building faithful Qur'anic generations. A mission he continues to fulfill at Imam Malik Institute with dedication and trust in Allah.
biography_muhammad_jola_camara.text065: Striving to serve the Book of Allah and build faithful Qur'anic generations — Muhammad Jola Camara

biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text004: A Gambian teacher of Arabic language and Islamic studies with long experience in teaching and administration. From the Kuttab of Drami family to a degree in Arabic and Islamic Studies, he has taught at Imam Malik Institute since 2007 and continues his mission in education and student development.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text009: From learning the basics of reading in the Kuttab of the Drami family to leading examinations and student affairs at Imam Malik Institute, Muhammad Kaowjed Camara has dedicated his life to teaching, nurturing student confidence, and organizing educational life with discipline and care.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text013: Born in Dimanaka Qadima, Yassi District, Republic of The Gambia, Muhammad Kaowjed Camara began his educational journey before 1991 in the Kuttab of Al Drami in Baghrini, under the tutelage of Sheikh Al-Hajj Bakr Drami may Allah preserve him where he learned the principles of reading and foundational Islamic knowledge.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text014: This traditional beginning instilled in him a love for learning and teaching that would shape his entire career.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text016: A Path From Kuttab to University
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text019: Started his learning in the Kuttab of Al Drami, under Sheikh Al-Hajj Bakr Drami, where he learned the basics of reading and Qur'anic principles.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text020: Salafi Association School Sheikh Mahmoud Sissi Camara Village
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text021: Joined the school of the Salafi Association in 1991 in the village of Sheikh Mahmoud Sissi Camara — may Allah have mercy on him. Studied Fiqh and all Islamic sciences, completing his primary stage in 2000.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text023: Moved to Serekunda and enrolled at the Islamic Union Institute (Landil King). Studied the preparatory and secondary stages from 2000 to 2007, successfully completing his secondary education.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text024: College of Islamic Da'wah Senegal Branch
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text026: In 2011, he gained admission to the College of Islamic Da'wah — Senegal Branch. Graduated in 2015 with a Bachelor's degree (Licence) in Arabic Language and Islamic Studies.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text029: His teaching career began immediately after his secondary graduation and has continued without interruption.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text031: Appointed as a teacher at Imam Malik Islamic Institute after graduating from the secondary stage, serving from 2007 to 2011.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text034: After graduating from university, he returned to The Gambia and resumed teaching at Imam Malik Islamic Institute since 2015, continuing his message in education and serving students of knowledge.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text038: Teaching linguistic and Islamic studies subjects at different academic stages at Imam Malik Institute.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text040: Established a student affairs committee to develop the institute and provide diverse student activities, focusing on training students to speak at the morning assembly to build self-confidence and eloquence.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text042: Preparing a monthly schedule for distributing teachers to supervise morning students and organizing daily educational life.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text044: Serving as Director of Examinations at Imam Malik Islamic Institute, managing academic evaluation.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text046: Internal monitor overseeing academic discipline, attendance and quality.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text048: Assistant for inspection works and assistant in organizing workflow at Imam Malik Institute.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text051: His approach combines classroom teaching with student development and administrative precision. Whether forming a committee for student affairs, training students to stand confidently before their peers, or organizing teacher supervision schedules, his work reflects a belief that education is both knowledge and character.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text052: Since 2015, he has continued this mission at Imam Malik, dedicating his efforts to teaching and to serving students of knowledge.
biography_muhammad_kaowjed_camara.text053: My mission continues in teaching and serving students of knowledge Muhammad Kaowjed Camara
